description: Get this repo's Shipyard config from zero (or partially done) to genuinely usable: write `.shipyard/config.json` (shared, tracked) and `.shipyard/config.local.json` (personal, gitignored), retire any leftover `SY_*` variables from a legacy `env` block, then prove it live with the same preflight check every other command runs. Asks only for what is actually missing, so a teammate joining an already-configured repo is a short exchange, not a full interview.
